Meridian Water

Meridian Water supplies pumps, treatment skids and network control systems to water utilities, irrigation districts and desalination plants in Australia, South-East Asia and the Middle East. Its largest installed base is in municipal pumping stations, where its variable-speed pumps have cut energy use by up to 30 percent.
